metadata.notes: v2.0: long scripture/sentence pairs removed from phrases; phrases now = word<->word entries + short non-compositional phrases; reusable question/statement templates added to grammar_rules (apply by ascending priority; $n captures are translated afterwards by the word/phrase pass).

subject_verb_inversion.description: Transforms singular class 1 subject prefixes combined with present tense 'waku-' followed by a verb root into English SVO order

sentence_negation_yayi.description: Captures standard present tense continuous negative statements ending with 'yayi'

sentence_negation_chara.description: Captures absolute negative or future tense negative statements ending with 'chara'

yes_no_questions.description: Handles question formations initialized by the 'kasi' marker

locative_prepositions.description: Translates structural locative noun classes into spatial context expressions

possessive_alignment.description: Reverses the Tumbuka Noun + Possessive structure to English Possessive + Noun structure (e.g., 'mwana wane' -> 'my child')

q_what_is.description: WH-copula question: (kasi) + SUBJECT + ni vichi  ->  what is SUBJECT. SUBJECT is any noun/phrase and is translated afterwards.

q_who_is.description: (kasi) + SUBJECT + ni njani/mbani -> who is SUBJECT

q_where_is.description: (kasi) + SUBJECT + yili/ili/wili/chili... + nkhu/mphani -> where is SUBJECT

q_where_are.description: plural concords vili/ghali/zili/ŵali + nkhu/mphani -> where are SUBJECT

q_what_does_mean.description: (kasi) + SUBJECT + wakung'anamula/chikung'anamula... + vichi (+ mu FIELD) -> what does SUBJECT mean (in FIELD)

q_what_does_mean_in.description: same as above with a subject area: ... wakung'anamula vichi mu biology -> what does X mean in biology

examples.tumbuka: kasi pala wakuti kutola matenda wakung'anamula vichi mu biology
examples.english: what does kutola matenda mean in biology

q_meaning_request.description: unganiphaliko ching'anamulo cha X -> can you tell me the meaning of X
q_meaning_request.replacement: can you tell me the meaning of $1

examples.english: can you tell me the meaning of agriculture

q_explain_about.description: Ka ungalongosoala vya X -> can you explain about X

q_what_can_i_do.description: kasi ningachita wuli kuti CLAUSE -> what can I do so that CLAUSE (literal, as in the source corpus)
q_what_can_i_do.replacement: what can I do so that $1

s_my_name.description: zina lane ndine/ni NAME -> my name is NAME

s_age.description: nili na vyaka N -> I am N years old

s_live_in_i.description: nkhukhala ku PLACE -> I live in PLACE

s_live_in_you.description: ukukhala ku PLACE -> you live in PLACE

s_live_in_he_she.description: wakukhala ku PLACE -> he/she lives in PLACE

s_live_in_we.description: tikukhala ku PLACE -> we live in PLACE

s_live_in_you_pl.description: mukukhala ku PLACE -> you live in PLACE

s_live_in_they.description: ŵakukhala ku PLACE -> they live in PLACE
